'''Chapter 478''' is titled "Luffy vs. Luffy".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Animal Theater|Animal Theater]]: [[Nami]] is decked out for the big cross-country race. Her vehicle of choice: a top-of-the-line, all-terrain tortoise.

==Short Summary==
With the Straw Hats besides [[Nami]] and [[Usopp]] defeated, hope is lost until [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], powered up, returns to battle [[Gecko Moria]] and [[Oars]].

==Long Summary==
[[Gecko Moria]] laughs and exclaims there are five [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] ([[Franky]], [[Brook]], [[Nico Robin|Robin]], [[Sanji]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]) down and three left ([[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], [[Nami]], [[Usopp]]) to go. As Nami and Usopp begin to panic, not knowing what else to do to battle Moria and [[Oars]], Zoro tells Usopp he will give him a shot and proceeds to attack Oars' right arm, using '''[[Three Sword Style]]: Yasha Garasu'''. When Oars proclaims that the attack is not going to work, Zoro prepares to use '''Tora Gari''', only for Oars to directly knock Zoro into a building, severely injuring him, and leaving two Straw Hats left still standing. Usopp then fired something into Oars' mouth, which was revealed to be salt. As Usopp explains to a confused Nami that salt is a zombie's main weakness, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s shadow begins to come out of Oars' mouth, only for Moria to use his [[Kage Kage no Mi|shadow]] to take the salt out and throw it back to a perplexed Usopp. Out of options, Usopp and Nami begin to lose hope, as Oars uses '''Gomu Gomu no Stamp''' to smash them both. A mysterious figure then appears on the side of Oars, asking him what does he think he is stomping on.

The mysterious figure turns out to be Luffy, having saved Usopp and Nami from Oars, however he has a [[Kage Kage no Mi#Nightmare Luffy|bulkier and more sinister appearance]] than normal. Nami and Usopp then thank Luffy for saving them, before they show surprise that it's him. As Usopp tells Luffy to be careful as Oars can use all of his techniques and even stretch himself, and as Moria wonders if Luffy is capable of transforming himself, he exclaims that it doesn't matter and commands Oars to use '''Gomu Gomu no Rifle''', only for Luffy to effortlessly block the attack with his hand, much to the shock of everyone. Luffy, telling Oars that "there is only one Monkey D. Luffy", punches Oars away. 

The [[zombie]]s of [[Thriller Bark]] notice a cloud above them, only for them to immediately realize that it's actually a flying Oars from being punched by Luffy, and proceed to evacuate the area. Much to the disbelief of the zombies, Nami, and Usopp, Luffy proceeds to pummel Oars around.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] is defeated by [[Oars]], and now there are two [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] ([[Nami]] and [[Usopp]]) left.
*[[Usopp]] shoots salt into Oars' mouth, only for it to be promptly removed by Moria's shadow.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] arrives at the fight as "[[Kage Kage no Mi#Nightmare Luffy|Nightmare Luffy]]".
*Nightmare Luffy begins to pummel Oars and Moria.
